questions.question: In the film, which two towers are the two towers?
questions.note: Saruman's tower at Isengard and Sauron's Dark Tower in Mordor, now allied.

questions.question: Who is the king of Rohan?
questions.note: Old and withered at first, under Saruman's spell.

questions.question: Which adviser has poisoned Théoden's mind for Saruman?
questions.note: Gandalf drives him out of Edoras.

questions.question: Who is Théoden's niece, the shieldmaiden of Rohan?
questions.note: She falls for Aragorn. He is promised to Arwen.

questions.question: Which nephew of Théoden is banished and gathers riders loyal to the king?
questions.note: Wormtongue has him exiled. He returns at Helm's Deep.

questions.question: What is the capital of Rohan, with its golden hall?
questions.note: The hall on the hill is Meduseld.

questions.question: What is the name of Théoden's son, who dies of his wounds?
questions.note: 'No parent should have to bury their child.'

questions.question: In what new form does Gandalf return after the Balrog?
questions.note: He takes Saruman's place, 'Saruman as he should have been.'

questions.question: What is Gandalf's horse, lord of all horses?
questions.note: He comes when Gandalf whistles on the plains.

questions.question: Whose spell does Gandalf break to free Théoden?
questions.note: Saruman is driven out of Théoden, who looks years younger.
